medications.drug: amoxicillin 875 MG / clavulanate 125 MG Oral Tablet
medications.sig: Take 1 tablet by mouth twice daily with food for 10 days

procedures.procedure: Telehealth visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Video Visit - Sinusitis
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Video visit from her car at work, identity verified, consents to telehealth.

Cold started about 12 days ago, got a little better, now worse for 3 days: R cheek and upper teeth pressure, thick yellow-green drainage, stuffy, low-grade temp to 100.2 last night. No vision change, no eye swelling, no severe headache, no stiff neck. This is her pattern, 1-2 sinus infections a year.
No antibiotics in the past 6 months. NKDA.

Exam over video: speaking full sentences, nasal voice, mild tenderness when she presses on R maxilla, no periorbital swelling or redness.

A/P: Acute bacterial sinusitis (double worsening after initial improvement), in a patient with recurrent sinusitis and diabetes. Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 BID x10 days. Saline rinses. Take with food, separate from calcium by 2 hours if she can. Return precautions: eye swelling, vision change, severe headache, high fever -> call same day or ED.
If more than 3-4 a year, would consider ENT.

documents.title: Sinus update
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Feeling better already, pressure way down. Do I still finish all 10 days?

documents.title: RE: Sinus update
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Glad you're improving! Yes, please finish the full course. Let us know if anything comes back.

documents.title: Diabetes Follow-up
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Last visit of the day. 1 yr out from bypass. Weight 88 kg (pre-op 114). Feels well. Sinus infection in Feb cleared with the antibiotic. Eating small meals, still some trouble with sweets (gets shaky and loose stools), avoids them.

Meds unchanged: metformin 1000 BID, lisinopril 20, B12, Ca/D, MVI.

Exam: BP fine. Heart/lungs nl. Feet nl, monofilament intact.

A/P
T2DM: A1c today. Has been under 7 since surgery. If it stays this low, could try reducing metformin, but she prefers to stay put for now and it's well tolerated.
Weight: BMI now 33, no longer in the severe range; taking severe obesity off the problem list. Bariatric clinic follows.
HTN: controlled.
RTC 6 months for physical.

documents.title: Appointment cancelled
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Pt called to cancel tomorrow's BP check, work deadline. PCP says fine to skip, BP has been good; see her at the physical in October.

documents.title: Bariatric Surgery 1-Year Follow-up
documents.author: bariatric surgery
documents.body:
Bariatric surgery clinic, annual visit 07/18/2023.
POD about 15 months after Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (course complicated by a gastrojejunal leak, repaired).
Weight 85.9 kg (pre-op 114 kg). Total weight loss about 25%.
Tolerating regular textured diet in small portions. Occasional early dumping symptoms with sweets, avoids them. No dysphagia or vomiting.
Labs: B12 420 pg/mL, 25-OH vitamin D 34 ng/mL, ferritin 46 ng/mL; CBC normal.
Plan: continue cyanocobalamin 1000 mcg daily, calcium/vitamin D and multivitamin. Annual labs and visit. Discussed that weight typically reaches its lowest point at 18-24 months.

reports.text: Digital screening mammogram with tomosynthesis, both breasts. Compared with 09/2021. Scattered fibroglandular densities. No new mass, distortion or suspicious calcification. Stable appearance.

documents.title: Mammogram result letter
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Your screening mammogram from 9/12/2023 shows no evidence of cancer. Next screening in 1-2 years per your doctor.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual exam. 47F.

Interval: bariatric clinic in July, labs fine there. Weight 84 kg, lowest it's been as an adult. Bought new work clothes twice this year. One sinus infection in February. Otherwise well.

Meds: metformin 1000 mg BID, lisinopril 20 mg, cyanocobalamin 1000 mcg daily, calcium carbonate/vit D BID, MVI.
NKDA. Never smoker, no EtOH.

ROS neg. Cycles still regular, a little heavier.

Exam: BMI 31.7, BP 124/78. Normal general exam. Thyroid nl. Heart RRR. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, scars healed. Skin nl. Feet nl, sensation intact.

A/P
- T2DM, well controlled post-bypass. A1c, CMP, UACR today.
- HTN controlled.
- Lipids: LDL has run upper 120s. Will recheck today.
- S/p RYGB, on lifelong supplements.
- HM: flu + updated COVID today. FIT kit. Mammogram done Sept, normal. Pap next year.
RTC 6 months.

documents.title: Follow-up
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
DM/HTN f/u. Up about 3.5 kg since the fall. Says portions creeping up and she stopped the lunchtime walks over the winter. Wants to get back on track. No GI complaints.

Meds unchanged. NKDA.

Exam: BP ok. Heart, lungs nl. Feet nl.

documents.title: Bariatric Surgery 2-Year Follow-up
documents.author: bariatric surgery
documents.body:
Bariatric clinic annual visit 07/16/2024. Two years after Roux-en-Y gastric bypass.
Weight 89.0 kg; nadir about 84 kg last fall. Some regain, which she is frustrated by. Reviewed eating pattern: grazing in the afternoon at work. Referred back to our dietitian.
No dysphagia, vomiting or abdominal pain.
Labs: B12 310 pg/mL (normal), vitamin D 31 ng/mL.
Plan: continue supplements. Dietitian follow-up. Annual visit.

reports.text: Specimen: cervical, liquid-based. Adequacy: satisfactory for evaluation; transformation zone component present. Interpretation: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy. High-risk HPV: not detected.
reports.conclusion: NILM, HPV negative. Repeat co-testing in 5 years.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Physical, 48F.

Weight is the main topic: 92 kg today, up 8 from her low a year ago. Bariatric clinic in July sent her back to their dietitian, who she saw once. Admits afternoon snacking at her desk. Very motivated to turn it around: plans a structured low-calorie plan and is joining the gym near her office. We set a goal of 5 kg in 6 months. Not interested in a weight loss medication right now; Medicaid coverage also uncertain.

Otherwise well. No sinus infections this year. Cycles regular.
Meds: metformin 1000 BID, lisinopril 20, cyanocobalamin 1000 mcg, Ca/D BID, MVI. NKDA.

Exam: BMI 34.9, BP 130/84. Gen nl. Thyroid nl. Heart RRR, lungs clear. Abd soft, scars healed. Pelvic: normal external genitalia, vagina and cervix; co-test collected. Skin nl. Feet nl, monofilament intact.

A/P
- Weight regain after RYGB: plan as above, recheck in 6 months.
- T2DM: A1c today.
- HTN: 130/84, at goal for her.
- HM: Pap/HPV today. Flu + COVID today. FIT kit. Mammogram due next year. PHQ-2 1.
RTC 6 months, weight and diabetes, fasting labs the week before.

documents.title: FIT and Pap results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: FIT negative. Pap from 10/22 NILM, HPV neg. Portal message to pt: both normal, Pap again in 5 years, FIT yearly.
